reviews.text: Very professional and caring for my dog. Answered all the questions I had also, is helping him get better. I'm ecstatic with the service and the attitudes, a great place to take your animal.

We’ve been taking our 4 year old bernedoodle here since he was a puppy. he can be very anxious but the staff always treats him with kindness and care and they are so patient! they are supportive and always available for any questions or other administrative needs, and we trust them to always give the highest standard of care.

The team here is incredible. Dr. Ogishi feels like a family member, always looking out for my pup. Even during a traumatic event while I was out of town, she was there via phone and text to help make sure he had the best care possible. And the rest of the team is equally as amazing - always responsive, caring, and reassuring. I’ll bring my best friend here now as well as every pet I ever have in the future.

So, I’m the type of person who tends to spend hours researching “the best of the best” when looking for new providers. When I adopted my dog 6 years ago as a first time dog mom, I asked many local Facebook groups for vet recommendations and saw AMC mentioned frequently & decided to give them a shot— and I am so glad I did. My dog & I have had many visits to AMC over the years with almost all of the doctors and have always had a 10/10 experience. The doctors and techs are all extremely knowledgeable and loving to my boy, always greeting him by saying “Hey kiddo!”. It always astonishes me how my dog who is usually terrified of strangers instantly warms up to every member of their staff. Plus, I love how I can give them a call or text when I have questions about my dog’s health & receive quick responses from his doctor or techs. Thank you for all that you do, AMC!

We chose AMC because they are fear free and one of our pups has shown fear-based aggression and had pretty terrible experiences having to be sedated at a past vet. AMC was able to fully sedate him for his visit without retraumatizing him or us.

Our other dog is a senior and basically needs a punch card for how often he’s at AMC as we try to get his complicated health conditions under control. Everyone knows him by name and treats him like their own. I get a call from Dr. Solomon after any test results, fully breaking down new info and giving recommendations and a call from the techs the day after all appointments just to check in.

I know they are getting the best care and we’ve had nothing but incredible interactions with all the staff. They even made our kitty a cool tank top post-surgery. 😎
I spoke to William about international health certificate and he was very helpful with information that I need. I appreciate the level of service and dedication.

Dr. Ogishi and the staff at Animal Medical Center of Chicago are fantastic! They are so caring and patient with our reactive Rottweiler. They are responsive and tailor his care to ensure he feels safe and is as comfortable as possible during visits.
We’ve been visiting this clinic for many years—everyone is happy: my wife, our cats, and I!

We have been taking our pets (Lakshmi-DSH cat) and Suki, (our 8 year old rescue) to Animal Medical Center of Chicago for 10+ years. Dr Solomon, all of the vets, vet techs and staff are exceptional in every way. Having them provide care to our pets gives us peace of mind. When my cat was dying, they helped me find a compassionate vet who would come to the home to help ease her pain. When we first adopted Suki, they helped me find appropriate support, training, and medication. We trust and highly recommend Animal Medical Center of Chicago.

I have been taking my dog Oliver to Animal Medical Center of Chicago for several years now. The front office staff, techs and doctors are truly the best around. We often see Dr. Simpson and she has been incredible. We also love Dr. England, Dr. Solomon, Dr. Ogishi and Dr. Forti. I am an over bearing dog mom and the level of care at AMCC is top notch. I appreciate the team always answering my questions, and I have a lot of questions. Thank you for ALL you do!

Close second after finding yourself a new doctor when moving is finding a great new vet. We couldn’t have gotten luckier. After an ok experience in the neighborhood and an atrocious one downtown, we struck gold. We went to our local vet for what she initially thought was a histiocytoma only to learn it was a tumor on her ear that needed to be removed. For the initial exam we were scheduled with Dr. Behnke the next week and then Dr. England performed the surgery within a month and we got her dental cleaning done simultaneously. Our pup and ourselves had met neither doctor before but both went out of their way to establish a rapport and care plan with all of us. Day of surgery went exactly as Dr. England laid out, timing, check ins, and pick up. His work on her ear healed amazingly well, quickly, and you’d never know she had surgery. And everyone from front desk on is helpful, works as a team and listens. I could not recommend this place and these folks more. They turned a very stressful situation into a well-managed, efficient scenario, and did all they could for us to ease our concerns. Thank you AMC of Chicago.

We love all the staff and professionals at AMC. Everyone we've interacted with has been so warm and friendly. Our large dog is reactive and needs to be sedated for vet visits for everyone's safety, and unlike other vet offices we've gone to, they do not treat us like we're a burden, and are so patient and attuned to our individual needs. They are well worth every penny, and I trust them 1000% with our family.

I can't say enough good things about this vet. We have three senior rescues: a 65lb shep/pit mix, a little white dog and an asthmatic cat so we're at the vet A LOT. When we moved to Chicago from California, we were worried about the transfer of care. I thank God for this place and their patience with us. Every member of the staff is equal parts kind and knowledgeable and you can tell they truly care about their patients. We give it 6 paws up.

Dr Donna Sullivan and her staff are just the best!! My cats are a handful at the vets. My 2 cats were handled with care and everything needed was accomplished. I have been going to Animal Center for many years…25-30 years? with all my cats. I don't want Donna to ever retire.

I want to share my recent experience in hopes that it will help other animals and their owners. I’ve been bringing my dog to this clinic for the past few years, which is why this experience was so upsetting and disappointing.
I brought my dog Lulu in recently because she was clearly not acting like herself—she was lethargic, not eating, had diarrhea, and had started limping. I was genuinely worried something was seriously wrong. I explained to the staff that she usually requires sedation for exams, but this time she was already unusually drowsy, so I wasn’t sure how they would proceed.
During the exam, when Dr. Simpson attempted to listen to her heart, Lulu became anxious and growled, so the exam was stopped. Dr. Simpson said she would come back with a plan, and when she did, she explained that she suspected something potentially serious like pyometra and recommended extensive testing and X-rays.
I understood the concern and agreed Lulu needed care—but the estimate I was given was around $2,500, which I simply could not afford. I asked if there was any way to work within my budget—whether we could prioritize certain tests or do anything at all to help my dog while I was there.
Instead, Dr. Simpson and the vet tech provided me with lower cost clinics and would not work with my budget to provide medical attention for Lulu. Dr. Simpson told me that my “money would go further at lower-cost clinics or in the suburbs". No alternatives were offered. No partial care. No attempt to meet me halfway. I was left crying, feeling helpless, and ultimately had to leave without my dog receiving any treatment at all—despite them acknowledging it could be a life-threatening condition.
I understand that veterinary care is expensive and that clinics have policies—but compassion, flexibility, and basic support in urgent situations matter too. I wasn’t asking for free care. I was asking for some level of help within what I could afford.
After years of trusting this clinic with my pet, I left feeling dismissed, judged, and unsupported during a genuinely scary moment. I hope this practice reconsiders how they handle situations like this in the future, because no pet owner should be made to feel this way when they are trying their best to get help for their animal.

Animal Medical Center of Chicago has been amazing. We came to them after a bad experience at big brand vet. We have never ran into any issues with them, every nurse and doctor are super kind and you can tell they enjoy their job. I would suggest them for anyone who needs a vet in the chicago area. They've taken care of her for her spay, and gave her a cute little onesie instead of a cone which we loved. They also habe helped with her digestive issues and just general care. Very satisfied!
Drs Janik and Solomon are the best as well as the staff. They have always taken such good care of my best friend's dog, Berkeley! He his lucky to have you in his corner! Than kyou for all you do!!

Had a FANTASTIC first visit with our senior dog with lots of health issues. The team spent so much time with us, handled our dog with so much care, and was so attentive to our needs. We appreciated their transparency in terms of pricing and collaboration to identify top priorities. So glad we found our new vet team!
We love the 5 star review!! Thank you for publicly acknowledging what we do best - care for your pets!
Thank you for the 5 star review and entrusting us in the care of your pet!  Its our honor and pleasure to be your partner is your pet's veterinary care.

The staff is super friendly and genuinely caring about our fur babies.

Their online portal makes it really easy to book and manage our pets medical records. Which is great for people like me who struggle with calling into places haha.

I've had dogs most of my life, and I've generally had good experience finding vets who really care about the animals in their charge.  Animal Medical Center takes it to a whole different level.  Everyone from the front desk, to the technicians, to the vets obviously loves animals. Nothing will completely remove the stress of a vet visit, but Animal Medical Center has really tried to eliminate the stressors for the animals (to the point that my timid scaredy-dog wags her tail and happily climbs the front steps to the office). And the vets are super thoughtful in diagnosing and treating the animals. Recognizing the difficulty of finding the cause of discomfort for a patient who cannot directly describe their symptoms, I have found that the vets do a unusually good job of interviewing owners and thoroughly examining the animals for possible causes. They are also super about outlining the range of possible treatments that could be tried, highlighting uncertainties and tradeoffs (including cost). I am a huge fan.

We have been going here with all of your dogs since they opened. I know that we get the best treatment here and that they follow up with our visits with our specialists (if we have one) and will always find an answer to our medical needs even if it is not at our appt. We love AMC!!!!!

We've been seeing Dr. Solomon since 2019, and I regret not finding her sooner! She is simply the best—thorough, caring, and professional. She always takes the time to carefully diagnose and examine my dog, and I can genuinely see how much she and her team care about him. One of the things I appreciate most is her honesty when it comes to treatment, medication, and any extras; she never pushes anything that she doesn't think is necessary. The staff is always on top of everything, extremely responsive, and quick to send insurance claims right after our visits. While the services may be a bit on the pricier side, it's worth it because I want my dog to receive the best care and treatment possible. Parking is never an issue for us, as there are four spots available in the back alley or street parking in front of the building.

Dr Janik and the Animal Medical Center team were extremely helpful, responsive, and caring while we worked to figure out my dog’s diagnosis and treatment plan. I have never once felt that unnecessary procedures, products, or tests were being pushed on me here. I would recommend this clinic to anyone needing veterinary care in Chicago. I wish I could give more than 5 stars.

***UPDATE: I was initially told the exam fee could be waived, but that offer was reversed after the owner, Dr. Solomon, declined to approve it. Choosing revenue over timely comfort for pets with a well-documented chronic history is unacceptable and speaks volumes about how clients are treated.***

I’ve been coming here for years and in the past this clinic felt like a true neighborhood, family style vet. Unfortunately, that has changed.

I recently requested a simple prescription refill for an ear ointment my dogs have been on for three to four years for routine maintenance. Despite the fact that my dogs had their annual exam and were seen in July 2025, well within the 12 month window, Dr. Behnke refused to refill the prescription without another exam.

I explained that this is not a new medication and that I cannot justify an additional $200 exam fee solely to refill a long standing prescription. I was told that if their ears were getting bad, I should bring them in, which would result in the additional charges on top of the medication.

What was most frustrating was the lack of consideration for my dogs’ comfort over the weekend. This is an ointment that has been prescribed many times before, not a new or controlled medication.

It’s disappointing that a situation as simple as a routine prescription refill is what will likely end a long term relationship with a veterinarian I once trusted.
Thank you for the 5 star review!  We are honored to be your chosen your veterinary care partner.

We started our relationship with Dr Solomon and Animal Medical Center about 35 years ago taking care of two Himalayan and Persian cats, then a golden retriever dog, then a golden doodle and now a multipoo.

I trust their team completely and have never considered an alternative.

Dr Nigishi is our primary now and really appreciate her attention to detail, follow up and concern.

We have 3 dogs, all with special conditions that require frequent care, and Animal Medical Center has been absolutely fantastic.  Our primary vet is Dr. Simpson and she has been a godsend, but we have seen almost every vet on staff and they are all kind, professional and thorough!  Highly highly recommend!

We’ve had such a great experience with this vet for our (almost) 13-week-old golden retriever, Vern! Scheduling is super easy, and we’ve never had an issue getting an appointment. I also love their texting system,  so helpful when you need a quick answer about scheduling etc.

We see Dr. England, and seriously love him. He’s super personable, great with Vern, and always asks good questions to make sure he really understands what’s going on.

The vet techs are all amazing too :) they’re always so sweet and seem so excited to see Vern, which makes every visit feel really positive.

Highly recommend!

I used AMCC from 2022 through 2024. I’m sure they love pets but I don’t know how places like this are in business. If your pet has no health issues other than some minor scrapes and cuts this vet is probably sufficient. I have senior pets and most vets do senior checkups but I have yet to discover what good those do since the only thing that seems to be different is that they do checkups 2xs/year instead of one.
In late summer/early fall of 2023, I took my cat in because he seemed to be having some delayed cognitive issues. He went from playing a lot to doing nothing. When I called his name or said the word food, which gets huge reactions in this house, he wouldn’t respond. He was throwing up his food often, very lethargic and just out of it. I took him in, explained all of the things I was seeing so they did some bloodwork. They said everything looked good and that he was just an old cat so I needed to adjust my expectations. This was the result for all three vet visits. Do they think I want to drop $300-500 per visit just for the hell of it? When I returned from the holidays he was barely able to do anything so I took him to MedVet. Turns out his potassium level was dangerously low, which the vet explained resulted in the cognitive issues I had witnessed and that it was probably caused by enlarged adrenal glands. Needless to say I was furious at AMCC for their failure to do an adequate assessment and began looking for a new vet. I left my previous vet (village west) for similar reasons with a different pet. Listen, you are around your pet almost daily. You know what’s normal and what isn’t so listen to your instincts. Had I listened to AMCC my cat would be dead.

Every time I visit, the staff goes out of their way to provide a explanation and breakdown. It is very refreshing to see the time being spent to go through the various potential causes for ailments, the different approaches with pros/cons and leaving the decision up to the pet owner. I feel very confident every time I come in that we will get to the bottom of the issue and have the best care plan recommended by the time I leave.

Our dog LOVES it here!! I’ve never seen a dog so happy and pull so hard, excited to come in for her appointments. Her appointments are usually with Dr England and Dr Simpson, both who take great care of her! The front desk staff are super sweet and love the capability to even text questions to the clinic.
Thank you for the 5 star review!!
The best vet practice I’ve ever been to, they go above and beyond
Thank you for the 5 star review! We appreciate the applause!

I cannot say enough good things about AMC and Dr. Janik. We have a senior cattle dog mix who is our life. She is also very anxious at the vet and often needs to be sedated. Dr. Janik was so kind to correspond with me via email and phone regarding some changes we’ve noticed in our girl to avoid stressing her out. Ultimately, she started losing her balance and when I called, they got me in same day. Everyone was so kind and helpful. Dr. Janik showed nothing but compassion, empathy, and understanding for my worry. We did all the tests we could to rule out as much as possible since my anxiety convinced me it was something awful. Thankfully, it was an expensive visit to find out it’s likely arthritis and we made a treatment plan moving forward. While AMC may be pricier, you get what you pay for which is utmost care, understanding and compassion. We are so thankful for them and the support we received today and are hopeful our treatment plan will support our girl for a long time and give her some of her sweet spunk back.

We received a very warm welcome as new patients.  Everyone has a very upbeat attitude and all seemed very knowledgeable.  Everything was explained to us and all concerns addressed. Very thorough follow-up.

Just felt the need to add to the original review.
We feel our two fur children are getting the best care around. It can take us at times an hour to get to AMC, but it is well worth the drive for the care they receive. The staff is very receptive to our concerns. They return our calls promptly. Highly recommend.

Not sure how I haven't reviewed AMC yet but I have been incredibly appreciative of their services for the past 2 years since we got our dog. Over this time we have worked with a number of their veterinarians and most recently / consistently Dr. Simpson. Every vet has been so helpful and understanding. Pippin is my first dog and I have never felt judged for asking my million "new owner" questions and they have been incredible partners with us as we've worked through emerging behavioral issues.

The front desk and vet techs are also amazing - I am so appreciative of their responsiveness over text message (and email! and phone!) to take care of quick questions. Every time we've had an issue with our dog, the team follows-up with us after the appointment over email with key takeaways of our discussion / next steps, and usually will call the next day just to make sure everything is still going well.

Lastly on the fear free component - I honestly always thought it was a little woo woo until we brought our dog to another chain vet to get vaccines. He was so spooked by the handling of the other vets that he had to be muzzled which was a shock to me and absolutely validated the quality of services provided by AMC! Overall, 10/10 love AMC and so glad we found them early in our time with our dog!
The whole team here is outstanding and we trust them so much with the care of our dog. I can't recommend them enough.

I cannot say enough good things about the Animal Medical Center of Chicago. They take their fear free certification very seriously. Our dog developed a lot of scared feelings around the vet after she was spayed, and Dr. Janik and the support team have gone above and beyond to ensure she is well taken care of while also not worsening her fears. My only regret is not taking our dog here when she was a puppy. It is pricier than other options, but well worth the cost if you have a scared pup like we do. 5/5 vet care!
Friendly and caring staff! We have a very active young golden retriever. They go above and beyond. When he had a tummy bug, the vet called the next day to check in on him.
We love the staff at AMC. They are always very helpful. They also have a phone number that clients can call or text at any time with questions or concerns.

Every single person at AMCOC is so unbelievably kind, welcoming, warm, and supportive. I have been to many vets, and they by far exceed them all. I will NEVER switch vets.

Thank you to everyone at AMCOC! Snickerdoodle and I appreciate each and every one of you <3

Everyone at AMCC is just wonderful. From making the appointment to the thorough post-appointment follow up, everyone was so kind and caring. We brought our very reactive dog Orla in for a medical issue and they were so incredibly kind and understanding with her. Their fear free methods made the visit a lot better for Orla. We are so glad we visited. And Dr. Behnke is SO kind and knowledgeable. She and Jessica both went above and beyond during our visit. We were so grateful!
They are always very direct and accommodate with us! They make us feel like our dog really matters to them and isn't just another patient.
Exceptional and compassionate care. The very best indeed! Dr. Solomon was at her best, again!

Amazing service, always so attentive and careful with my dog. You can tell the staff and team care overall for the health of your pets, I will establish with AMCC for my current pet and future pets :)

I absolutely love this office! I recently got two kittens with my boyfriend and our roommate and their customer service and pet care is absolutely fantastic. Dr. Simpson is so down to earth, sweet and patient!
Good dependable pet care
